description: Profiles one company or person across USPTO TTAB proceedings: how many times they appear as plaintiff (the one opposing or petitioning to cancel) versus defendant (the one being opposed), a breakdown by proceeding type, every name spelling they have been filed under, and the proceedings themselves. Answers "how often does this company oppose other trademarks", "is this brand an aggressive TTAB litigant", "who has this company been in TTAB disputes with". Reads several result pages. Sourced live from USPTO TTABVUE.

limit.description: Max proceedings to return in the list, up to 125. Default 50.

match_mode.description: How the party name is matched. Default contains.

max_pages.description: How many 25-row pages to read, 1-5. Default 2.

party.description: Party name as filed, e.g. "Monster Energy Company". A distinctive word matches more reliably than a full legal name.

name: ttab_party_history
title: Ttab Party History
